correctness.rationale: A smooth complex quartic K3 surface has line squares -2 and Hodge index. Reproduced each of the 24 line-containment identities, 276 pair determinants, 32 distinct triple concurrences and graph maximum clique 3 from exact parameters; the 16x16 Gram determinant is -1728. The binary equivalence Mx=3*1 follows from Hodge index. All 2^8 completions are exhausted and exactly 64 pass all 24 equations. Each divisor is cut by a unique degree-three homogeneous polynomial and cannot have a linear factor, hence cubic irreducibility. Independent exact Smith and determinant calculations check the rank and index-three hyperplane defect; the packaged standard-library script passes.
